messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey there! 

i'm tal - your personal talent agent. think of me as your inside person in the bangalore tech scene.

i don't do small talk or career advice. i find people actual jobs at companies that pay real money. the kind of roles that feel like they were made for you.

hi

hey! 

i'm tal - your talent agent. not here for chit chat, here to get you a better job.

think of me as your inside person in the tech scene. i know which startups are actually hiring, who's paying well, and what roles are worth your time.

what's your full name?
can you find me product manager jobs in bengaluru ?

yo hold up - i'm not a job board that spits out random listings

i'm a talent agent. i find roles that actually fit YOU specifically. your background, your level, what you're worth.

but i need to know who you are first. what's your full name?
Shubham Kumar Sah

shubham kumar sah... solid name. 

alright, product manager in bengaluru. i can work with that. but i need to know your background to find roles that actually match your level.

where you working currently?

iit kgp to iim b to powerschool... that's a solid trajectory. bain capital backed, 600k+ users, $2.2M ARR unlock. you're not messing around.

34% activation bump by fixing blank-slate screens... classic growth PM move. and that genai assistant with 73% time reduction? that's the kind of stuff that gets noticed.

swiggy to edtech is interesting. what made you jump from food delivery chaos to education platforms?
its more on b2c to b2b rather than domain

ah makes sense. b2c chaos at swiggy to b2b2c at powerschool. different game entirely - longer sales cycles, more stakeholders, but way more predictable revenue.

how long you been working total?

senior pm with your growth chops... that's the sweet spot. you've got the metrics to back it up.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
6 years

6 years and already at PM II level with that kind of impact... you're moving fast.

what kind of role you looking for next?
senior PM
major Indian cities should be fine
6 years + senior pm + major indian cities... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
yes

YOOO SHUBHAM! 🔥

you're officially in the tal fam now. that iit-iim combo with real growth metrics? we're about to make some noise in the market.

your profile's locked and loaded. when the right senior pm roles drop - the ones where you can flex those activation and retention muscles - you'll be the first to know.

time to level up from that powerschool gig to something that really moves the needle. let's get you paid what you're actually worth.

welcome to the chaos, legend! 🚀
